b: I knew about the Conan stuff he has been linked to in years, which will be a King Conan feature. Could be interesting. I can not see how a sequel to Commando would work though. Yes, Vernon Wells (Benett) is alive, but he's 80 as well. Plus, Benett got killed in the original. Heck, all the enemy characters got killed. You could perhaps bring Alyssa Milano back as his daughter, but it would be weird to get her kidnapped again.

Not to mention Commando was Arnold in peak shape. That was the point. I don't really see a slower John Matrix working in the same way as it did in the 80's. I think the type of movie could still be fun, but Arnold may have aged out of it.
